run_cifar10_baseline_training: run the main function to train a CNN on CIFAR-10 and generate a submission CSV
train_model_cifar10: train a two-layer convolutional neural network on CIFAR-10 using Hugging Face Trainer
load_and_preprocess_cifar10_data: load the CIFAR-10 dataset and preprocess images into normalized PyTorch tensors
evaluate_model_predictions: evaluate a trained model on the test dataset and return predictions and label IDs
create_submission_csv: create a CSV submission file from model predictions with predicted labels
